Available port indexes are unknown for this EID. There is no universal valid range. Leave blank to use the only active port; routing refuses if more than one is active. For an explicit index, refresh detection or read it from a privileged LPA. Manual entry identifies a real card; it cannot spoof an EID.

Route to this eUICC
Enable routing

This changes the destination of ALL new downloads in SIM Manager, including QR-code installs, not only transfers. Use this module on the receiving phone only. Close any existing transfer first. After saving, restart SIM Manager and Google Play services through your framework before starting a fresh transfer, plus Phone if scoped. Nothing is downloaded by this button. A real transfer can deactivate the source line.
Preserve card session
Preserve card session: ON
Preserve card session: OFF
Enable session preservation
Disable session preservation

Keep the selected eUICC’s native APDU channel open across metadata authentication and the following download while the native service remains bound. This option is off by default. Requires Phone (com.android.phone) in owner-user scope and compatible native session hooks. Close transfers, then restart all scoped processes through your framework before testing; restarting Phone interrupts cellular service. Check READY:PHONE as well as LPA/GMS readiness. No process is restarted by this button.
Close transfers first, then restart all scoped processes, including Phone, to restore native channel handling. Restarting Phone interrupts cellular service. No process is restarted by this button.
Off / forget destination

Close any running transfer first. This clears the destination and disables session preservation. Existing routed processes block further routed operations after a settings change until they restart. Restart all scoped processes, including Phone if scoped, to restore stock behavior. Restarting Phone interrupts cellular service. This does not undo a carrier transfer or remove a profile.

Scope SIM Manager and Google Play services, owner user. Add Phone only for session preservation. Restart all scoped processes after settings changes. Carrier authorization still applies. A card list or framework connection is not proof that all routing hooks are loaded.

only active port
Diagnostics

Record locally before an attempt, then stop and review the report. Root access and a visible notification are required. Only reviewed status labels, error codes, versions and saved routing mode/port/session option are kept; no identifiers, activation codes, tokens, QR/session material, APDUs or raw messages. Recording stops at your time limit or 1 MiB. Nothing uploads automatically; you choose the export destination. Unknown or suppressed messages and the other phone’s logs are unavailable. Nearby events can also come from other Play services features.
